description: This PHP source file defines the class OX_Extension_DeliveryLog_AggregateBucketProcessingStrategyPgsql, which handles processing and pruning of aggregate buckets in a PostgreSQL environment for the Revive Adserver project. It includes methods for migrating data from aggregate buckets, executing batch inserts, and cleaning up old data.

classes.name: OX_Extension_DeliveryLog_AggregateBucketProcessingStrategyPgsql
classes.description: A class for processing and pruning aggregate buckets in PostgreSQL for the delivery log extension in Revive Adserver.

methods.name: processBucket
methods.description: Processes an aggregate bucket by migrating data up to a specified end date, batching inserts for efficiency.

methods.name: pruneBucket
methods.description: Removes records from a bucket table up to a specified end date, optionally within a date range.

methods.name: getBucketTableContent
methods.description: Retrieves the content of a bucket table as a recordset up to a specified end date.
